dish: Galley Boy — double cheeseburger with barbecue and tartar sauces, topped with a green olive, brought to the car by curb-hops
w: Akron's own drive-in: 'Pop' Swenson sold burgers from his station wagon at Buchtel High in 1933 and opened the first stand on S. Hawkins Ave in Wallhaven in 1934. The Galley Boy (Forbes once called it 'America's best cheeseburger') is the city's signature sandwich; Signal Akron readers voted Swensons best burger in 2025.

dish: Frozen custard (flavor of the day) from Bill Strickland's batch-freezer recipe
w: Founded in 1936 by Bill and Florence Strickland and still in its original Triplett Boulevard stand; Bill, an Akron Pure Milk man, built his own batch freezer to keep air out of the custard. Its seasonal opening day is local news every spring.

dish: Thick, scratch-made-daily crust pepperoni pizza and its famously cheesy salad (cash only)
w: Downtown since 1949 (Nick and Rose Ciriello), an old-school, cash-only late-night pizza room so beloved it became 'Montoni's' in the Funky Winkerbean comic strip. Signal Akron readers' best pizza 2025; Akron Life's Flavor Awards 2026 best Summit County restaurant.

dish: Chicken paprikash — paprika-heavy chicken with onions, hot peppers and handmade dumplings
w: A family-run Balkan tavern founded by Croatian immigrants (Rade and Lucija Juric) — Akron's keeper of its Eastern European table, with chicken paprikash as the famous plate.

dish: Northern & Southern Italian plates with fresh fish and center-cut steaks — and the house white French dressing Papa Joe's is credited with introducing to Akron
w: The Iacomini family's Merriman Valley dining room, open since 1932 — Akron's celebration-dinner standby. Signal Akron readers voted it the city's best restaurant in 2026.
Downtown Thai-and-sushi room that won both reader polls: Signal Akron's best restaurant (2025) and Akron Life's 2026 Flavor Awards best downtown Akron restaurant.

dish: B.O.R.I.S. the Crusher oatmeal imperial stout (two-time Great American Beer Festival gold)
w: Akron's internationally exported craft brewer (since 2006, beers sold in 36 countries), known for big imperial stouts; a living-room-style tasting room on the Summit Brew Path.

dish: Labrador Lager and the seasonal Pumpkin Ale (cash-only taproom)
w: A Summit Brew Path mainstay brewing regional classics like Labrador Lager; the Sour Haus is up the street at 529 Grant St.

dish: House-brewed beers with an upscale pub menu
w: North Hill brewpub that Signal Akron readers voted best bar/brewery in both 2025 and 2026; an official Summit Brew Path stop.

dish: Barberton chicken dinner — lard-fried chicken with fresh-cut fries, slaw and hot rice ('hot sauce')
w: One of the Barberton chicken houses founded by Belgrade Gardens alumni: the Serbian-American Milich family opened it in 1955; after the family closed it at the end of 2014 it reopened a month later under new owners as Village Inn Chicken, same recipe.
